title: Compatible sections of finite lisse sheaf towers
statement: Let I_n be finite locally constant set sheaves on the small etale site of a scheme X, with morphisms r_n:I_(n+1)→I_n and nonempty geometric stalks. There is an affine weakly contractible pro-etale cover indexed by Type u and compatible sections of all comparison inverse images of I_n on each member. No epimorphism condition on r_n is required. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-constructible-locally-constant], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

source.place: Tag 03RV representability; Tag 09BV compatible universal sections; original compatible-trivializations steps 1 and 4--5.

proof.text: Represent I_n by finite etale P_n and turn r_n into p_n by full faithfulness of uliftYoneda. The stalk of a representable maps surjectively to the lifted geometric fiber: a germ (V,z,f) is sent to f(z), and every fiber point is represented by the identity at P_n. The representing isomorphism therefore transfers finiteness and nonemptiness from I_n to the geometric fibers.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-tower-cover] to obtain compatible maps a_jn:U_j→P_n.

Send the universal section t_n corresponding to the identity of P_n through the comparison adjunction unit, then restrict along a_jn. Yoneda gives r_n(t_(n+1))=p_n^*(t_n). Naturality of the unit in sheaves and in site objects, followed by a_j(n+1)≫p_n=a_jn, proves the required section equation.

theorem finite_lisse_tower_section_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : ℕ → Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (r : ∀ n : ℕ, I (n + 1) ⟶ I n)
    (hI : ∀ n : ℕ, IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets (I n))
    (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X), Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (I n))) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (U : J → X.ProEt),
      Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ (U j).left) (fun j ↦ (U j).hom) ∈
          proetalePrecoverage X ∧
      (∀ j : J, IsAffine (U j).left) ∧
      (∀ j : J, (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (U j)) ∧
      ∃ s : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ),
        ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt X)
          (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology X)).obj (I n)).obj.obj
            (op (U j)),
        ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ),
          ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt X)
            (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology X)).map (r n)).hom.app
              (op (U j)) (s j (n + 1)) = s j n
